segments.sn54.11:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā icchānaṅgale viharati icchānaṅgalavanasaṇḍe.
segments.sn54.11:1.4: Nāmhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenā”ti.
segments.sn54.11:1.5: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
segments.sn54.11:2.1: Atha kho bhagavā tassa temāsassa accayena paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.sn54.11:2.2: “sace kho, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ –
segments.sn54.11:2.3: ‘katamenāvuso, vihārena samaṇo gotamo vassāvāsaṃ bahulaṃ vihāsī’ti, evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe, bhikkhave, tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha –
segments.sn54.11:2.4: ‘ānāpānassatisamādhinā kho, āvuso, bhagavā vassāvāsaṃ bahulaṃ vihāsī’ti.
segments.sn54.11:2.5: Idhāhaṃ, bhikkhave, sato assasāmi, sato passasāmi.
segments.sn54.11:2.6: Dīghaṃ assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāmi, dīghaṃ passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāmi;
segments.sn54.11:2.7: rassaṃ assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāmi, rassaṃ passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāmi;
segments.sn54.11:2.8: ‘sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti pajānāmi … pe …‘paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmī’ti pajānāmi,‘paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmī’ti pajānāmi”.
segments.sn54.11:3.5: Ye te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū sekhā appattamānasā anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamānā viharanti tesaṃ ānāpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato āsavānaṃ khayāya saṃvattati.
segments.sn54.11:3.6: Ye ca kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū arahanto khīṇāsavā vusitavanto katakaraṇīyā ohitabhārā anuppattasadatthā parikkhīṇabhavasaṃyojanā sammadaññā vimuttā tesaṃ ānāpānassatisamādhi bhāvito bahulīkato diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārāya ceva saṃvattati satisampajaññāya ca.

lines: 987-988. Dutiyavaggassa paṭhame evaṃ byākareyyāthāti kasmā attano vihārasamāpattiṃ ācikkhati?

Sace hi te “na jānāmā”ti vadeyyuṃ, atha nesaṃ titthiyā “tumhe ‘asukasamāpattiyā nāma no satthā temāsaṃ vihāsī’ tipi na jānātha, atha kasmā naṃ upaṭṭhahantā viharathā”ti upārambhaṃ āropeyyuṃ, tato mocanatthaṃ evamāha.
Sekkhavacaneneva tesaṃ sikkhitabbassa atthibhāve siddhepi sikkhitabbarahitesu tesupi sekkhapariyāyassa vuccamānattā sikkhitabbasaddena sekkhe visesetvā vuttā.
Āsavakkhayatthaṃ sikkhitabbassa abhāvepi diṭṭhadhammasukhavihāratthaṃ jhānādisikkhanena vinā sikkhitabbābhāvā “asekkhā nāmā”ti vuttā.
Buddhānaṃ pana sabbaso sammadeva pariniṭṭhitasikkhattā “sikkhāmī”ti na vuttaṃ.
